svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print with the lips and ears on the bed; the end walls bridge 26 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside 62.4 x 26.4 mm, walls 2 mm, 12 mm tall to the shell ceiling.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lips 2 mm wide under both long edges of the board, 1.75 mm thick.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four ears 7 x 7 x 2.5 mm with 3.4 mm holes, 19 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, 30 mm behind and 10 mm ahead of the body centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stick 0.5 mm foam tape on the lips so the board cannot rattle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the display board drops in face up; the frame then goes into the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upturned top shell with four M3 x 8 screws into the frame bosses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The screen sits 0.25 mm under the shell ceiling, behind the window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the board drops in without force and the screen is centred.
